bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; q="SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM posting_deliveries d JOIN announcement_posts a ON d.source_type='announcement' AND d.source_id=a.announcement_id::text AND d.owner_user_id=a.owner_user_id WHERE d.telegram_message_id=4639 AND d.status='sent' AND a.kind='recruitment' AND a.status='published' AND (a.conditions->>'dmScreenMessageId') ~ '^[0-9]+$') THEN 0 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM posting_deliveries d JOIN announcement_posts a ON d.source_type='announcement' AND d.source_id=a.announcement_id::text AND d.owner_user_id=a.owner_user_id WHERE d.telegram_message_id=4639 AND d.status='sent' AND a.kind='recruitment' AND a.status='published') THEN 81 WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posting_deliveries WHERE telegram_message_id=4639 AND status='sent' AND source_type='announcement') THEN 82 ELSE 83 END"; code=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -tAqc "$q" | tr -d '[:space:]'); case "$code" in 0|81|82|83) exit "$code";; *) exit 84;; esac
